subject: Security next steps: Requesting Type II package, bridge attestation, and portal invite for PulseIQ
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@pulseiq.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@pulseiq.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Great demo — security items and next steps

Hi Asha / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — enjoyed the discussion about integrating Redwood inference into PulseIQ's care-coordination workflows. Per our call, a few security/compliance items came up that we'd like to align on so your security and procurement teams can complete the intake. Action items below: 

- Please confirm whether PulseIQ requires a SOC 2 Type II report (most teams request the most recent report and an interim bridge letter).
- If yes, we'll share our Type II package and a signed bridge attestation; we can also provision read-only access to our Trust Portal for your reviewers.
- Any specific DDQ/Vendor Security Questionnaire you prefer (we can complete via PDF or provide a one-click Trust Portal upload)?

Next steps I propose: if you confirm Type II is needed, I'll send the report and bridge letter, and invite your security contact to the portal for evidence review. If you prefer, Ben from our compliance team can join a short call to walk through artifacts.

Attachments: none on this message.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Company: Redwood Inference
From: Asha Patel <asha@pulseiq.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great demo — security items and next steps

Hi Neha,

Appreciate the follow-up and the clear list. PulseIQ will require the SOC 2 Type II report plus a bridge letter since our procurement team needs to sign off before legal can approve the SOW. 

We also have a short vendor DDQ (I attached v1) — it covers data residency, retention, encryption, and subcontractor lists. Could you confirm the following for our initial intake?

- Is Redwood's most recent Type II report calendar-year 2027?
- Can you provide a signed bridge attestation that covers the period since the report?
- Do you support HIPAA DPA language and provide audit logs for customer-specific activity?

If you can provision Trust Portal read-only access for our security reviewer (Tom Reynolds, tom.reynolds@pulseiq.com) that would speed things up. Ideally we'd have the materials by end of week so procurement can schedule their review.

Attachments: PulseIQ_DDQ_v1.pdf (Vendor DDQ, 6 pages)

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Director, Vendor Risk | PulseIQ
asha@pulseiq.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great demo — security items and next steps

Looping in to confirm availability and what we can distribute immediately:

Neha — we have the SOC 2 Type II (report for FY 2027) and I can produce a signed bridge letter that covers Q1–Q3 2028. We can redact any customer-identifying artifacts. We also support HIPAA via our standard DPA; audit logs for customer-invoked inference requests are retained per the customer's region policy and can be exported on request (I'll include the export instructions).

Plan to do:
- Prep the Type II report PDF (redacted) and the bridge letter (signed).
- Provision Trust Portal read-only link for Tom (invite will be scoped to 'evidence view' and expiration 30 days by default).
- Fill out PulseIQ DDQ (Ben will take the technical sections; Marissa can address process and attestation questions).

Marissa — can you take ownership of the DDQ answers and coordinate with our legal team for any DPA redlines?

I will aim to have the package ready and the portal invite sent by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: none
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Hi Asha / Tom — quick update and delivery as promised. Thanks for the patience.

What I've attached / provisioned for PulseIQ:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027_Redacted.pdf (Type II report, redacted for customer confidentiality)
- Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2028-07.pdf (signed bridge attestation covering Jan 2028–Jul 2028)
- PulseIQ_DDQ_v1_answered.pdf (our completed DDQ; Marissa handled process/QAs, Ben handled technical sections)

Trust Portal access:
- Invite sent to Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@pulseiq.com) with 'evidence view' permissions.
- Portal link (read-only): https://redwood.trustportal.example/portal/INV-4892 — credentials sent in invite email. Access expires in 30 days; we can extend upon request.

Quick answers to the specific questions you raised:
- Most recent Type II report: FY 2027 (attached redacted).
- Bridge attestation: signed and attached, covers the period since the report.
- HIPAA & DPA: we support HIPAA via our standard DPA; Marissa has opened a ticket with Legal for any specific clause redlines.
- Audit logs: export instructions are included in the DDQ answers (section 4).

If you'd like a 20–30 minute walkthrough of the portal or a call with Ben to review technical artifacts, I'm happy to schedule for early next week.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027_Redacted.pdf (PDF), Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2028-07.pdf (PDF), PulseIQ_DDQ_v1_answered.pdf (PDF)
